questions.question: I am about to change the signature of ADBUtils.click_element, the `click_element` method on the ADBUtils class defined in backend_host/src/lib/utils/adb_utils.py. Which repo files contain calls to `.click_element(...)` on an ADBUtils instance (for example an `adb_utils` / `self.adb_utils` object, or an ADBUtils object returned by a helper)? Ignore everything under features/. Test files count. Calls to `.click_element(...)` on other classes (AppiumUtils, the Playwright web controller, remote controllers' own `click_element` wrappers, mocks of other classes, ...) do not count. Comments, strings and def lines do not count. Answer with the list of file paths.

I am about to change the signature of TelloRemoteController.execute_command, the `execute_command` method on the TelloRemoteController class defined in backend_host/src/controllers/remote/tello.py. Which repo files contain calls to `.execute_command(...)` on a TelloRemoteController instance (for example a `ctrl`, `controller` or `self` object whose runtime type is TelloRemoteController)? Ignore everything under features/. Test files and scripts count. Calls to `.execute_command(...)` on other controller classes (BashController, ADBUtils, AppiumUtils, BaseMobilityController, other remote controllers, ...) do not count. Comments, strings and def lines do not count. Answer with the list of file paths.

The Flask route handled by `get_task_status(task_id)` in backend_server/src/routes/server_script_routes.py is mounted at GET /server/script/status/<task_id> (blueprint `server_script_bp`, url_prefix '/server'). Which repo files outside that route file send HTTP requests to that exact URL (for example `/server/script/status/${taskId}` passed directly or through helpers such as buildServerUrl, buildServerUrlWithParams, hostScopedUrl, an `api.get(...)` MCP client, or a test/script `_api("GET", ...)` helper)? Both frontend/ TypeScript files and Python files (backend_server, scripts, tests, test_scripts, ...) count; ignore everything under features/. Files that only mention the URL in a comment or docstring do not count. Requests to different routes such as /host/... status routes or /server/transcript/status do not count. Answer with the list of file paths.

I am about to change the signature of normalize_script_ref, the module-level function defined in shared/src/lib/utils/script_identity_utils.py. Which Python files contain calls to it (via a top-level import, a function-local import, or a module attribute such as `script_identity_utils.normalize_script_ref(...)`), including calls inside script_identity_utils.py itself? Ignore everything under features/. Tests and scripts count. Files that only mention the name in a comment, docstring or string, or that define/call a different function with a similar name, do not count. Answer with the list of file paths.

If the signature of resolve_script_identity (module-level function in shared/src/lib/utils/script_identity_utils.py) changes, which repo files are affected two levels up? Level 1 = files containing calls to resolve_script_identity (comments/docstrings/monkeypatch string names do not count as calls; ignore everything under features/). Level 2 = files containing calls to the functions/methods that enclose those level-1 calls. For enclosing methods, only count calls on the owning class: TestCaseExecutor (backend_host/src/services/testcase/testcase_executor.py) or ScriptExecutor (shared/src/lib/executors/script_executor.py) as appropriate; for an enclosing Flask route handler (such as execute_script in backend_server/src/routes/server_script_routes.py), treat it as a terminal node: it has no level-2 callers, so do not search for HTTP callers. Answer with the union of level-1 and level-2 file paths (a file in both counts once). Answer with the list of file paths.
